title: Level-orbit potentials: quantifier audit, speed criterion, and transnormal rigidity
exact_target: Find planar potentials whose trajectories remain on an initial equipotential when launched tangentially.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002550 (AIM-PHYSICS-0058). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Variational Methods in Celestial Mechanics; notes by Kuo-Chang Chen, version 22 June 2003, source item 21.

status_qualification: The source does not exclude constant potentials, specify regularity or say whether every tangential speed or a selected speed is meant. These choices change the answer and must be identified; no nontrivial universal quantifier is invented. The inherited solved label is not a fresh proof endorsement. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
